Resolves #22066

The workbench code view now shows the config an example wrote, its children included, overlaid with the configs a visitor changes. Until now it showed `module` alone until something changed. The viewport copies the config `createExampleComponent()` returns before `Neo.create()` consumes it. The formatter now comments out a function or live instance where it sits, instead of dropping the whole value around it. `tab/container`, `button/base` and `list/base` return their config; the other 37 examples that build their own instance convert in #22068. No file under `src/` changes, and D#21480's engine contract stays open.

Evidence: L3 (a headless Chromium probe of this head, served locally) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2 and AC-5 are the code view in a real browser). Residual: none.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline jobs run in CI.

Frame critique: as released, both code panels show three lines (`{`, `module`, `}`). As changed, `tab/container` shows its authored config from `module` down to its tabs (76 lines). `button/base` shows its configs and its `menu` (65 lines), with each `handler` as a comment line. The longer code fills the panel to its 178 px cap and scrolls (`overflow-y: auto`; 1,388 px of content for the tab container). At 900 px, the inspector above therefore shows about five fewer rows, and it still scrolls as before. Not changed here: a one-item array still spans three lines.
